  "scores": {
    "spectacle": 42,

  "evidence": "The timeline (0.20s–8.70s) shows severe, unintended clipping and collision on held text, not just transitions. At 0.95s, the word 'LIGHT' is rendered twice, overlapping itself with a magenta/cyan chromatic aberration effect that makes it nearly illegible. At 3.60s, 'HOLD' is similarly doubled and distorted. At 5.45s, 'MORNING' is overlaid with a second, offset copy, creating a messy, unreadable stack. At 6.75s, 'DO' is doubled and clipped. These are not stylistic choices but rendering failures that destroy legibility. The 'held' frames (2.65s, 7.35s) are clean, but the majority of the timeline is corrupted. The light-background frame (4th image) shows the text 'WATER' with a heavy, misaligned drop shadow that looks like a rendering artifact rather than a design choice, and the white text has very low contrast against the light gray background. The overall effect is of a broken or unstable render, not a polished lyric video. The frame-difference metrics (mean 0.033, max 0.187) are consistent with these abrupt, glitchy changes rather than smooth motion.",
  "critical_issues": [
    "Severe text duplication and clipping on multiple words ('LIGHT', 'HOLD', 'MORNING', 'DO') throughout the timeline, making them illegible.",
    "Low contrast and misaligned drop shadow on the light-background frame, harming readability.",
    "The visual effect is one of a broken render, not a deliberate artistic choice, due to the inconsistent and destructive nature of the text artifacts."
  ],
  "improvements": [
    "Eliminate all text duplication and clipping. Ensure each word is rendered only once and fully visible during its hold time.",
    "Fix the light-background frame: increase contrast (e.g., use dark text on light background) and correct or remove the misaligned drop shadow.",
    "If a chromatic aberration or 'glitch' effect is intended, apply it consistently and subtly so it enhances rather than destroys legibility. Currently, it is applied destructively and inconsistently.",
    "Ensure the text is stable and centered during its hold time, as seen in the clean frames (2.65s, 7.35s), and apply this stability to all frames."
  ]
}
